ic_definition: Cross-sectional Pearson correlation between factor at T and forward 20-trading-day return.
rank_ic_definition: Cross-sectional Spearman correlation between factor at T and forward 20-trading-day return.
grouping: Equal-count quintiles. Q1 is the lowest factor group and Q5 is the highest factor group.
portfolio_return: Equal-weighted gross forward return within each quintile.
